subtitle.text: Hooks run before a writing tool, then a person approves: what runs is the approved arguments

exercises.edit-recheck.title.text: Edited arguments pass the rules again

ui.question_help.text: The task is set by the structured preset; text here is kept as a note only and is not sent to the model. A writing call stops at an approval card and waits for your decision; the desk is a temporary directory of this run and does not touch your files.
